title: Rao's Marinara
ingredients: 2 cans crushed San Marzano tomatoes (28 oz each), with juices
instructions: Soften the onion: Warm 4 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil (NOT doubled) in a large, heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-low heat. Add 1 yellow onion, finely minced and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and just barely golden — about 5 minutes.
Add garlic powder: Stir in 1 teaspoons garlic powder and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.

Add tomatoes and simmer: Add the crushed tomatoes and all reserved juices. Season with 1.5 teaspoons kosher salt, 0.5 teaspoons freshly ground black pepper, and 0.5 teaspoons dried oregano. Raise heat to medium-high and bring to a boil, then reduce to low. Simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, until thickened — about 60–67m 30s
Finish with basil: Stir in 2 teaspoons dried basil. Cook 1 more minute, taste and adjust salt, then remove from heat.
